svg.text: PCB state machine: going back after a change
Each row is one kind of change. A filled box is a state where the work starts again. Rows come from tools/pcb-transitions.json.
The tool stops work on a board until a change has an event: tools/pcb change BOARD --kind KIND --reason TEXT --by NAME
part review, schematic, bom, rules, route plan, layout, and later
part review, bom, layout approval, gate, release, readiness
part review, bom, layout approval, gate, release, readiness
schematic, route plan, layout approval, copper, gate, and later
stackup, route plan, layout approval, placement, copper, and later
layout approval, placement, copper, gate, release, readiness
layout approval, placement, copper, gate, release, readiness
rules, layout approval, placement, copper, gate, release, and later
route plan, layout approval, copper, gate, release, readiness
layout approval, placement, copper, gate, release, readiness
nothing; the event names each path
Two or more boxes in a row: the possible starts. The machine uses the earliest one. A kind with no file group is named by a person, and no tool finds it alone.
